title: Night phase -- wolf vote, seer peek, doctor save
sub_tasks: Wolf vote: wolves select a victim (consensus among alive wolves)
Seer peek: seer selects a player to inspect (learn if wolf or not)
Doctor save: doctor selects a player to protect
Night resolution: kill vs save, queue morning announcement
Night timer (30 seconds per action phase)
All actions are private -- no timing leak, resolve at end of night
